name: reprompt
description: Rewrites a rough prompt into a stronger one. It finds missing context and blind spots, interviews you about them, shows the optimized prompt, and offers to run it in place of the original.

interface.shortDescription: Optimize a prompt before the work starts
interface.longDescription: Reprompt classifies a prompt as planning, goal or missing information. It reads local instruction files for context, asks two to four targeted questions, and rewrites the prompt in plain language with a goal, constraints, deliverables and a definition of done. It then offers to send the optimized prompt, optimize it further or show a diff.
defaultPrompt: Use reprompt to optimize this prompt: plan the migration of our logging library.
Use reprompt on: make the HMI faster.
